description: Design DNA capture — extracts palette, type stack, motifs, motion, and 3D signatures from a shipped HTML file and saves them as a reusable reference pack. Use when the user says /reimagine-it lock, "lock this design", "save design DNA", "capture this look", or wants to reuse a shipped design on a different target. Locks capture palette, type, motif, and motion from a shipped HTML file. Part of the reimagine-it Content-Derived Design suite.
